given: A WebSocket transport (WebsocketsTransport) is connected to a server that supports the graphql-ws protocol. The server sends a subscription message with a payload containing an incremental item: {"data": {"user": {"id": "1"}}, "incremental": [{"data": {"name": "Alice"}, "path": ["user"]}], "hasNext": true}.
when: The client calls session.execute_incremental(query) and iterates over the yielded results.
observe: What is the .data attribute of the first yielded result? Does it contain the accumulated data (e.g., {"user": {"id": "1", "name": "Alice"}}) or only the raw delta (e.g., {"user": {"id": "1"}})?
